adjudication.rationale: In `packages/features/bookings/lib/handleCancelBooking.ts`, the top-level cancellation path was updated to handle multiple calendar references (`bookingToDelete.references.filter(...)` and then `for (const reference of bookingCalendarReference)`), but inside the recurring-cancellation branch it still does `const bookingRef = updBooking.references.find((ref) => ref.type.includes("_calendar"));` (single reference) while looping over *all* calendar credentials. With the new multi-destination-calendar support, each `updBooking` can have multiple `_calendar` references (one per host/credential), so using `.find(...)` will only delete whichever reference happens to come first, leaving other hosts’ recurring events undeleted.
